name: Ykslammi Beach
description: The village beach on Ykslammi: a smoke sauna, a pier, a lean-to with a fire ring. In winter there's a hole in the ice for the brave.
greeting: Someone is already in the lake, howling.
A disc golf frisbee lands in the reeds.
The fire is going at the laavu.

hello: The stove's been heating since morning.
Leave your worries in the changing room.
sausage: Sausage after sauna. The only way.
broke: The sauna fee goes in the tin. You're short.
refuse: Easy now. Once a week is plenty.
Your skin is still pink! Next week.

requires.message: Your skin is still pink from the last round. Come back next week.

effects.message: Löyly hisses on the stones. All worries melt away.

requires.message: Once a week is plenty in water this cold.

actions.label: Grill a sausage at the laavu

requires.message: One sausage is tradition. Two is just lunch.

effects.message: Nothing beats a sausage after sauna.
